question: How do credits work?
answer: Credits are used to generate images. Each AI model costs a different amount of credits per generation depending on its quality and speed. Subscription credits reset each billing period, while top-up credits purchased as one-time packs never expire.

question: What AI models are available?
answer: We offer multiple AI models with different quality levels and credit costs. Higher-quality models produce more realistic results but use more credits per generation.
